title: Human tasks checklist
summary: Manual gates for the learning loop, knob calibration, and promotion decisions. Automated weekday runs are listed for context — verify, do not duplicate. Cadence map: docs/ops/ops-review-cadence.md.

tasks.title: Spot-check learning tracks after paper-auto
tasks.summary: Confirm weekday CI acted; on Automation tab compare AI judgment excess vs ^FTSE, rules control, and calibrated shadow knobs.

tasks.title: Paper-auto + decision-review apply
tasks.summary: Runs all learning tracks, refreshes overlay, appends rebalance_log, applies clamped knobs when history is thick. Calibrated shadow is observe-only (no --apply).

tasks.title: Read analysis review synthesis
tasks.summary: After analysis-review (~10:35 UTC), read analysis_review.md for backward metrics, proposed experiments, and ingest trials.

tasks.title: Review knob calibration priors
tasks.summary: Inspect knob_calibration_priors.json: ready_for_priors, confidence, score_gap_vs_runner_up, cohort discriminability, and changed_vs_current.

tasks.title: Compare calibrated shadow vs primary AI judgment
tasks.summary: On Automation tab, compare forward marks and epoch excess for ai_judgment vs ai_judgment_calibrated before promoting any prior.

tasks.title: Promote knob priors only when gates pass
tasks.summary: Do not edit ai_judgment config until ready_for_priors, score gap ≥ 0.005, confidence acceptable, and shadow forward marks support the change.

tasks.title: Triage analysis_tasks experiments
tasks.summary: Promote scoring/ingest candidates manually via ftse-analysis-review promote; keep paper_knobs and offline_sim experiments manual.

tasks.title: Knob calibration + analysis-review agent
tasks.summary: analysis-review.yml runs ftse-knob-calibrate (with cohort fitness for AI tracks) and spawns calibrated shadow when priors exist.

tasks.title: Follow unified ops review cadence
tasks.summary: Use the weekly → monthly → quarterly sequence in ops-review-cadence.md (analysis review, horizon scan, deferred ideas) rather than ad-hoc review order.

tasks.title: Horizon scan + deferred fragments
tasks.summary: First Sunday 11:00 UTC: read horizon scan output; triage open ftse-defer fragments and deferred ideas.

tasks.title: Deferred ideas review pass
tasks.summary: Review deferred-review.md; move items via ftse-defer status (done / drop / promote).

tasks.title: Verify decision packs before live capital
tasks.summary: For real-money trades, use decision-pack verify checklist and primary sources — separate from the automated learning loop.

tasks.title: Paper-learning review experiments
tasks.summary: When churn or exit-timing cohorts mature, run paper-learning review probes manually; do not auto-apply from shadow cohorts yet.
